consequence.statement: New CLI capability only: `flux [reconcile|suspend|resume] image policy` commands become available in the flux CLI; the evidence states no change to existing behavior and no operational consequence for an operator who does nothing.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 implements new `flux [reconcile|suspend|resume] image policy` CLI commands (reconcile, suspend and resume for image policy).

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the change adds flux CLI subcommands; no subject family covers CLI subcommands — the closest, cli-flag, is defined for command-line flags with a leading --; applicability: the evidence only states that the commands were implemented; it names no resource kind, chart value, flag, gate or version range a static environment condition could test — the new subcommands are simply present in the flux 2.7.0 CLI for every installation
